## FIX-2 per-contributor design table (all line refs = /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/scripts/fr10_phase4_patch_vllm_tree_gdn.py unless noted; per-draft = per spec-draft commit event, B=1, cat9 T=9 nodes, 48 GDN layers; measured rows from output/fr13_b1_kernel_attrib/{delta,runtime_api}_per_draft.csv)

### Measured-storm cross-check used for attribution (raw rows)
- runtime_api: cudaMemcpyAsync 219.06/draft chain vs 96.82 native; cudaStreamSynchronize 116.85 vs 2.12; cudaLaunchKernel 331.08 vs 189.88 (delta = +141.2 eager launches/draft — NOTE: the task brief's "+190" matches the NATIVE absolute 189.88, not the delta; raw row quoted, discrepancy flagged).
- window_summary: chain memcpy_kind2 (DtoH) 5262 copies/48 drafts = 109.6/draft, 27,156 B total (~5 B avg = .item()/tolist class); kind1 (HtoD) 2631/48 = 54.8/draft at ~70 B avg (native 2082/51 = 40.8/draft) → +14 tiny HtoD/draft.
- delta CSV: indexSelectSmallIndex 819.58/draft (+2.79 ms), vectorized+unrolled elementwise 2110.8 (+2.29 ms), CatArrayBatchedCopy(+_vectorized) 710.5 (+1.29 ms), index/scatter misc (index_elementwise 125.9 + elementwise_kernel_with_index 459.94 + _scatter_gather 205.12) ≈ 791 (+1.13 ms).
- COUNT-CONSISTENCY ATTRIBUTION (labeled inference, class 12): the big kernel-COUNT rows are dominated by IN-GRAPH conv-emulation/tree-prep nodes inside the captured verify forward, not by eager code: per GDN layer per draft the emulation block visibly does ≥3 index_select (:1273-1275 prior_window, :1280 window, :1283 path0_x) ⇒ 48×17ish ≈ 816 ≈ measured 819.6; torch.cat :1276-1279 = 48/draft + drafter/emulation cats ⇒ ≈710 total; per-node masked writes 48×9=432 ≈ elementwise_kernel_with_index 459.9 (eager committer adds only ~4-6). These execute via cudaGraphLaunch (hence absent from the +141 eager-launch delta). CONSEQUENCE: most of the +8 GPU-ms storm is conv-emulation = FIX-3 territory (fp-reduction/dtype changes, class-10 byte A/B bar). FIX-2's reclaimable pool = the EAGER subset: ~102 blocking DtoH+syncs, +141 eager launches, +14 tiny HtoD, plus the bind's "true serialization residual ~4.7 ms/event".

| # | Site (file:line) | What it is / op-by-op count per draft | Measured storm row it feeds | Replacement mechanism (semantics-preserving) | Expected saving (ESTIMATE) | Size | Risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2a | committer 6x `.cpu().tolist()` :4088-4098 (parents, drafts, parent_targets, self_targets, bonus, counts) + replay-flag reads `.item()`x2/layer :4515/:4521 | 6 blocking DtoH + 96 flag DtoH = ~102 of the 109.6 kind2-DtoH/draft (94%) and ~102 of the 116.85 cudaStreamSynchronize/draft; 0 kernels | runtime_api kind2/StreamSync rows | ONE packed DtoH: init-time persistent device staging int64 + pinned CPU mirror sized [5T+2B+96] laid out [parents|drafts|parent_targets|self_targets|bonus|counts|flag_matrix(48x2)]; device-side: ~7 small async slice/cast copies into staging, ONE `staging_cpu.copy_(staging_dev, non_blocking=True)` + one stream sync; unpack by Python slicing. Flag matrix included = ALL-LAYER batched flag validation: every layer's [fresh, staged-rows] still checked individually in Python with the same per-layer error messages (REPRESENTATIVE-LAYER VALIDATION BANNED — failed safety twice; this is the sanctioned path from FR13_SPEED_CHASEDOWN_FINDINGS.md "only valid flag-sync optimization"). Requires flags stacked at init: one [48,2] int32 tensor, each layer's `_fr13_replay_flags` = row view created at init (forward's captured fill_ writes hit identical addresses every step — class 6 preserved). `counts` kept on its existing CPU branch when already a list. | ~102 blocking readbacks → 1; ≈1.5-2.5 ms wall (each blocked readback ≈15-25 us round-trip on an idle queue) | M (~120 lines + init stacking) | LOW. Values byte-identical (same ints, one transport). Check ordering: flags are forward-written, complete before committer; validate-all-then-launch reads only pre-launch state. Class 3 n/a (staging disjoint from sources). |
| 2b | 48 per-layer eager replay launches :4541-4558 (`launch_tree_gdn_replay`, src/lumo_flywheel_serving/fr10_gdn_tree_kernel.py:709, grid=(spec, VH, cdiv(DV,BV))) + per-layer `fill_(0)` :4559 | 48 eager Triton launches + 48 fill_ launches = ~96 of the +141 eager-launch delta; GPU busy 3.36 ms (a WASH vs native fused_sigmoid 3.36 — no GPU-ms claim, launch/gap overhead only) | cudaLaunchKernel row; _tree_gdn_replay_kernel row | ONE batched all-layer launch: stack rings at init — one allocation per ring kind [48, ring_bs, n_pad, KH, DK] (k/v/a/b), each layer's `_fr13_replay_ring_*` (alloc site :343-385) becomes a fixed layer-slice view so the captured forward write-code at :2928-2939 is UNCHANGED (same addresses, class 6); stack A_log/dt_bias [48, VH] at init (read-only bitwise copies); per-layer ssm banks differ → prefer OFFSET TABLE if all banks share one KV-pool storage (check untyped_storage().data_ptr() equality at init), else int64 device pointer table + Triton int64→tl.pointer_type cast (verify Triton version in container source, CPU-only docker); table built once, each commit re-asserts every layer's bank data_ptr unchanged (cheap Python int compares — all-layer, no representative shortcut). Kernel variant: grid=(spec*48, VH, cdiv(DV,BV)), pid0→(layer,spec); per-program body source-identical, SAME constexprs (NUM_KH/DIM_K/DIM_V/BLOCK_V); layers are independent (each writes only its own bank rows; accepted_paths/lens shared read-only) so concurrency reorders nothing within any program's sequential scan. Single `flags_stacked[:,0].fill_(0)` after launch (clear-after-consume invariant preserved for all layers). Boundary diagnostics (`_fr13_bnd_layer_on` :4529-4566) → keep verbatim legacy per-layer loop whenever boundary env is ON (diagnostics default OFF). | 96 launches → 2; ≈0.7-1.4 ms wall (eager launch+gap ~7-10 us each on GB10 with drained queue) | L (~150-line kernel variant + ~120 wiring + offline byte test) | MEDIUM (highest in FIX-2): per-program math identical in source+constexprs but new compile = class-10 codegen risk → gate by INT-VIEW byte A/B of bank bytes batched-vs-legacy-48-loop on banked capture payloads (FR10_TREE_GDN_CAPTURE_PAYLOAD harness :2683-2739), never atol; then live gate. Fail-loud if stacking preconditions (uniform dtype/shape across layers) don't hold — no silent per-layer fallback (class 9). |
| 2c | committer per-element HtoD writes: `output_token_ids.fill_(-1)` + per-element `output_token_ids[req_i,pos]=int` :4300-4303; `accepted_tree_rows.copy_(torch.tensor(...))` :4304-4307; REQKEY paths/lens publish :4346-4359; replay paths/lens publish :4481-4496 | per event ≈1 fill_ (vectorized_elementwise) + 3-6 index_put (elementwise_kernel_with_index, the eager ~4-6 of 459.9) + 3-6 scalar HtoD + 5-6 pageable `torch.tensor(...)` HtoD with host-side staging syncs ⇒ ~10-14 of the +14 kind1-HtoD/draft | kind1 HtoD row; elementwise_kernel_with_index row (eager share) | SINGLE pinned HtoD staging: init-time pinned int32 buffer + persistent device staging carrying [out_rows matrix Bx(max_spec+1) with -1 padding | accepted_rows B | reqkey paths Bxcols + lens B | replay paths Bxcols + lens B]; write ints into the pinned numpy view, ONE async HtoD, then ~6 device-side slice `copy_` calls into the existing destination tensors (destinations and consumers untouched; kernel-input layouts unchanged). fill_(-1) replaced exactly: the staged matrix writes -1 to every element fill_ covered (assert len(out_rows)==output_token_ids.size(0), else fall back to fill_ + batched row write). Gather-then-scatter, staging disjoint from dst (class 3). | ~10-14 HtoD + ~5 kernels + ~6 host syncs → 1 HtoD + ~6 async copies; ≈0.3-0.6 ms | M (~90 lines) | LOW. Same values to same elements; REQKEY and replay publishes both kept even when identical (no skip-if-unchanged reasoning — class 8 interval risk EXCLUDED). |
| 2d | runner tree-metadata build + HtoD :5643-5725 (per-node Python loop building _parents/_target/_self/_draft, then 3x `torch.from_numpy(...).to(device, non_blocking)` pageable) | 3 pageable HtoD/forward + ~36x4 Python appends; feeds kind1 + cudaMemcpyAsync rows | runtime_api memcpy rows | Values are a pure function of (tuple(num_draft_tokens), tree topology): precompute parents_template/offset templates once; per forward, vectorized numpy (template + sampled_start affine offsets); cache the 3 DEVICE tensors keyed by the exact value-determining tuple — cache hit (steady B=1) = ZERO HtoD and zero list building; miss = rebuild via one pinned HtoD. Exact-equality cache key, no staleness heuristic. | 3 HtoD + Python loop → 0 on hit; ≈0.2-0.4 ms | S (~50 lines) | ZERO-RISK class (cache key = the full value domain; identical tensors). |
| 2e | runner depth-positions :5867-6016 (per-step np.empty x2 + torch.from_numpy + pageable .to(device) + positions copy_; mrope CPU writes) | 1-2 pageable HtoD + per-req Python loop/forward | cudaMemcpyAsync row | Persistent pinned _fr10_depth_pos buffers allocated once; write in place, positions[:N].copy_(pinned_view, non_blocking) — removes per-step allocs + pageable staging sync. Values change every step → NO caching (EXCLUDED as value-risk-free impossible); transport-only change. | ≈0.05-0.1 ms | S (~25 lines) | LOW (transport only). |
| 2f | runner REQKEY pre-forward rewrite :6308-6392 (2x pageable `torch.tensor(...).copy_` per forward + per-row list building) | 2 pageable HtoD/forward | cudaMemcpyAsync row | Stage rows+lens through the same persistent pinned buffer pattern (one HtoD + 2 slice copies). Do NOT skip writes when the by_req dict "should" equal buffer contents — EXCLUDED (class 8 producer/consumer-interval reasoning). | ≈0.1-0.2 ms | S (~40 lines) | LOW. |
| 2g | sampler eager tree ops :5220-5243 | per event: 1 big gather `logits[tree_self_logits_indices]` (indexSelect, ~5 MB read), 1 .to(fp32) (~9.9 MB write), 1 `.clone()` (~9.9 MB rw), 2 argmax (reduce_kernel), 2 .to(int32), 1 torch.stack→CatArrayBatchedCopy + contiguous ≈ 8-10 eager kernels | indexSelect/elementwise/Cat rows (eager share) + reduce_kernel | (i) Drop the `.clone()`: advanced-index gather ALWAYS materializes fresh storage (never aliases `logits`), so in-place mutation by processors/constraints cannot touch `logits`; clone is a bitwise-identity third copy. (ii) Preallocate persistent [2,T] int32; `out[0].copy_(argmax)` / `out[1].copy_(argmax)` — copy_ casts in-kernel, removing stack-cat + 2 cast kernels + contiguous. KEEP the gather, .to(fp32), apply_logits_processors, apply_sampling_constraints, and the entire non-greedy branch untouched (anything touching sampling VALUES is out of scope). | ~4-5 kernels + ~0.07 ms copy; ≈0.1-0.2 ms | S (~25 lines) | LOW for (ii); (i) zero-value-risk by the gather-materialization argument but flag for red-team sign-off since it deletes a stock-mirroring defensive copy. |
| 2h | Trivials (bind queue item 4, verified by census): `:1192 _fr10_weight_f` truly dead (1 cast x48/draft); `:3159` self-copy verified dead (launch_tree_gdn_prepared writes into out= and returns it; 48 copies/draft); `:1173/:1178` per-layer `torch.arange` x2 (96 const kernels/draft) → hoist to metadata init; `:1283 _fr10_path0_x` NOT DEAD (FR10_METRICS=1 consumers :1481/:1625-1642) → move INSIDE the gated metrics branches only, never delete | ~192 in-graph kernel nodes/draft feeding the vectorized_elementwise + indexSelect count rows | elementwise/indexSelect rows (in-graph share) | Delete/hoist under the flag; these are in-graph so the win is graph-node count + ~0.2-0.4 GPU ms of the measured elementwise storm | ≈0.2-0.4 ms GPU + node-count reduction | S (~25 lines) | LOW (dead/const code verified by holds=True census; :1283 handled per the explicit caution — diagnostics-off byte gate cannot catch that breakage, so gated-move not delete). |

### Ranking (expected saving x size x risk)
1. **2a packed DtoH + all-layer batched flag validation** — biggest wall win (1.5-2.5 ms), LOW risk. Do first.
2. **2b batched all-layer replay launch** — 0.7-1.4 ms, MEDIUM (class-10) risk, largest code. Do second, behind its own offline byte A/B before live.
3. **2c committer pinned HtoD staging** — 0.3-0.6 ms, LOW.
4. **2d runner metadata cache** — 0.2-0.4 ms, zero-risk class.
5. **2h trivials** — 0.2-0.4 GPU ms, LOW.
6. **2g sampler quick wins** — 0.1-0.2 ms, LOW (clone-drop needs red-team sign-off).
7. **2e/2f pinned transports** — 0.15-0.3 ms combined, LOW.

### EXCLUDED (any value-changing risk)
- Conv-emulation fusion / any fp-reduction reorder or dtype/cast change (the in-graph ~819 indexSelect / ~432 cat / bulk of 2110 elementwise) → FIX-3 with class-10 byte A/B bar.
- Representative-layer flag validation in ANY form (BANNED — failed safety twice; first-layer and last-layer both demonstrated unsafe per FR13_SPEED_CHASEDOWN_FINDINGS.md).
- Skip-if-unchanged shortcuts for REQKEY/flag/replay publishes (class 8 producer-consumer interval).
- Anything in the sampler non-greedy path, constraints, or logits values; lm-head changes (that is the post-FIX joint-lm-head lever, both arms).
- Deleting :1283 _fr10_path0_x (gated-move only).
- Caching depth positions across steps (values change every step).
design.flagPlan:
## Flag plan — FR13_EAGER_PACK (one flag, FIX-1 A/B pattern)

- **Single flag `FR13_EAGER_PACK`, default OFF (0) until the lossless gate passes.** OFF = exact legacy code paths VERBATIM: every change is `if _fr13_eager_pack: <new> else: <legacy block unchanged byte-for-byte>` — same pattern as FR13_DRAFTER_SINGLE_LOGITS in FR13_B1_FIX1_GATE_BIND.md. All sub-fixes (2a-2h) ride the one flag; no per-sub-fix flags.
- **Init-time allocations are flag-conditional but allocated at init regardless of later flag flips within a boot** (env read once at module/init scope; class 6 — no per-step allocation in either state). Stacked rings/flags replace the per-layer allocations at the SAME init site (:343-385) when ON; per-layer views preserve the captured forward's write addresses.
- **Boundary-diagnostics interaction:** when FR13 boundary env is ON, the replay path uses the verbatim legacy per-layer loop even with FR13_EAGER_PACK=1 (diagnostics default OFF per flag-gate-metrics rule); the needle reports which route ran.
- **Launcher passthrough** (mirror FIX-1's wiring): `scripts/fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh` — default block next to :38 (`FR13_EAGER_PACK=${FR13_EAGER_PACK:-0}`) + `-e FR13_EAGER_PACK="$FR13_EAGER_PACK"` next to :166; `scripts/fr10_launch_speed_server.sh` — same at :85 and :188. Recorded in container_env.txt per arm, asserted by the runner before any probe.
- **Engagement needle (class 9), fires in BOTH states:** `logger.info_once` at first commit: `FR13_EAGER_PACK committer path engaged: pack=<0|1> layers=<48> packed_dtoh_bytes=<n> replay_batched=<0|1> stacked_rings=<0|1> boundary_legacy_loop=<0|1>` — present in every tree-arm docker log, absent in no-spec arms (inverse engagement). FAIL-LOUD: with flag ON, if stacking/pointer-table preconditions fail, RAISE at init (no silent per-layer fallback — the class 9 vacuous-instrument trap).
- **Measured engagement instrument (class 12 raw counters):** one short `LUMO_NSYS_TRACE=cuda,cuda-sw,nvtx` capture asserting kind2-DtoH/draft drops ~109.6 → ~5-8 and eager cudaLaunchKernel/draft drops ~331 → ~200-220; reducer based on output/fr13_b1_kernel_attrib/analyze_kernels.py (the FIX-1 engagement-capture pattern).
- **Gate (reuse FR13_B1_FIX1_GATE_BIND.md verbatim):** (0) fresh PRE-change temp-0.6+greedy captures both arms with pinned prompts output/fr13_acceptance_ladder/prompts_swe4.json, seed 1313; (1) within-boot same-seed repeat byte-identity, both flag states (class 8 first gate); (2) OFF-vs-ON served-stream byte-identity with the class-11 mismatch rule (on any fork, re-boot OFF and bracket by the OFF-vs-OFF cross-boot floor FIRST); (3) accept/event exact within boot, within OFF band cross-boot; (4) regular-decode pristine probe (code-path-unreachability + no-spec floor fallback as in FIX-1); (5) speed verdict on metrics-clean run, basis decode_seconds/spec_drafts. PLUS the FIX-2-specific pre-live gate: 2b's batched replay must pass int-view byte A/B of bank bytes vs the legacy 48-loop on banked capture payloads (class 10, never atol) BEFORE any boot. Note class 8: all offline byte proofs are necessary not sufficient — the live B=1 same-seed repeat is the first binding gate; the GPU gate run is the separate follow-up owned by the GPU workflow.
design.projectedLanding:
## Projected post-FIX-2 landing (ALL FIGURES ESTIMATES, labeled per class 12)

Baseline: post-FIX-1 chain5 0.2294 s/fwd vs native 0.2182 = 11.2 ms gap (cat9 0.2373).

FIX-2 reclaimable pool is bounded by two measured facts: (a) the bind's "true serialization residual ~4.7 ms/event" (sync/launch bubbles — items 2a/2b/2c/2e/2f live here), and (b) only the EAGER+trivial slice of the +8 GPU-ms storm (~0.5-1.0 ms; the in-graph conv-emulation bulk is FIX-3). Itemized (estimates): 2a 1.5-2.5 + 2b 0.7-1.4 + 2c 0.3-0.6 + 2d 0.2-0.4 + 2h 0.2-0.4 + 2g 0.1-0.2 + 2e/2f 0.15-0.3 ≈ **3.2-5.8 ms nominal, call it 2.5-4.5 ms after overlap with the wait-absorption caveat** (committer blocking time partially absorbs GPU-busy; the FIX-1 bind's demoted-hypothesis row).

**Projected chain5: ~0.225-0.227 s/fwd ≈ 1.031-1.041x native** (from 1.0513x). Cat9: ~0.232-0.234 ≈ 1.064-1.072x (same mechanism, topology-independent). This does NOT reach the B1-3 <=1.0x bar by itself — expected and consistent with the bind's queue ordering.

## What stays for FIX-3 (and beyond)
1. **Conv-emulation fusion** (queue item 3): the in-graph storm bulk — ~816/draft indexSelect (+2.79 ms), ~430 cat (+1.29 ms share), bulk of 2110 elementwise (+2.29 ms), ~432 masked index-writes — fused conv kernel replacing the per-layer Python emulation; fp-order/dtype changes ⇒ class-10 byte A/B bar; also the graph-node lever (clean-capture graph-launch CPU 0.71 vs 0.29 ms/draft basis; conv-fusion node-savings mapping still unproven per the bind — confirm by node-count measurement when it lands).
2. **Tree-GDN net +1.7 ms** and TREE_ATTN +0.3 (kernel-level, not data movement).
3. **Joint lm-head sub-native lever** (fp8 / split-N): native itself pays 85.15 ms/draft = 39% of its forward — the route to strictly-faster-than-native for BOTH arms (user stretch goal). Out of FIX-2 scope entirely (changes values at fp level ⇒ own gate).
4. The cat9 accept/event superset blocker (2.15 vs native 3.16) remains the B1-2 lossless re-chase — unrelated to and unblocked by FIX-2.
design.summary:
FIX-2 design complete (CPU-only, no commits, no GPU). Read the live patch code at every census site plus FR13_B1_SPEED_ATTRIBUTION_BIND.md, FR13_B1_FIX1_GATE_BIND.md, FR13_SPEED_CHASEDOWN_FINDINGS.md, FR13_BUG_CLASS_PLAYBOOK.md, and the raw CSVs in /home/mark/shared/lumoFlyWheel/output/fr13_b1_kernel_attrib/.

Key attribution finding: the headline kernel-COUNT storm (819.6 indexSelect, 2110.8 elementwise, 710.5 cat) is mostly IN-GRAPH conv-emulation nodes (count-consistency: 48 layers x ~17 index_select ≈ 816; 48x9 masked writes = 432 ≈ elementwise_kernel_with_index 459.9) — that GPU-ms bulk is FIX-3. FIX-2's true pool is the EAGER tax, which the runtime-API CSV pins precisely: 109.6 tiny DtoH/draft (96 = the 48-layer flag .item() pairs at :4515/:4521 + 6 committer tolist at :4088-4098 = 94% of all DtoH), 116.9 stream syncs, +141 eager launches (96 = replay+fill at :4541-4559), +14 tiny HtoD (committer :4300-4307/:4346-4359/:4481-4496). Also flagged: the task brief's "+190 eager cudaLaunchKernel/draft" appears to be the native absolute (189.88); the measured delta is +141.2.

Design: 8 ranked items under ONE flag FR13_EAGER_PACK (default OFF, legacy verbatim in else-branches): (2a) single packed DtoH carrying all six committer inputs PLUS the stacked 48x2 flag matrix — all-layer batched flag validation preserving every layer's check (representative-layer BANNED); (2b) one batched all-layer replay launch via init-time stacked rings (per-layer views keep forward writes unchanged) + bank offset/pointer table, grid layer axis, same constexprs, gated by int-view byte A/B vs the legacy loop on banked capture payloads (class 10); (2c) single pinned HtoD staging for all committer writes; (2d) exact-key cache for the constant runner tree-metadata tensors; (2e/2f) pinned transports for depth-positions and REQKEY rewrite; (2g) zero-risk sampler wins (provably-redundant clone, prealloc argmax buffer — values untouched); (2h) verified trivials (:1192 delete, :3159 self-copy delete, :1173/:1178 arange hoist, :1283 gated-move only per the census caution). Excluded with reasons: anything fp-reordering, skip-if-unchanged shortcuts, non-greedy sampler paths, representative-layer validation.

Projected landing (estimates): reclaim ~2.5-4.5 ms of the 11.2 ms gap -> chain5 ~0.225-0.227 s/fwd (1.031-1.041x native); conv-fusion (in-graph storm + graph nodes), tree-GDN +1.7 ms, and the joint lm-head sub-native lever remain for FIX-3+.
